create_config_schedule_meeting: create a pyspiel config for meta-generated meeting schedule negotiation games with two players
build_scenario_schedule_meeting: build a Scenario dataclass for schedule meeting with sender, receiver, out-of-office days, and day preferences
create_observation_summary: create an Observation dataclass with summary prefix and postfix prompts for conversational dialogue summarization
create_payoff_schedule_meeting: create a Payoff dataclass with a prompt, min and max utility values, and observation transformation prompts for evaluating meeting agreement outcomes
run_get_config: run get_config to retrieve a ConfigDict containing game parameters, observations, payoffs, scenarios, and LLM termination prompts for schedule meeting negotiation
